name: Distillates (petroleum), solvent-refined middle; Gasoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained as the raffinate from a solvent extraction process. It consists predominantly of aliphatic hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C9 through C20 and boiling in the range of approximately 150 °C to 345 °C (302 °F to 653 °F).]
